Name: Qi's Magic Water Ball
Author: TacNotCat
Description:
[AI-translated] English below, Chinese version further down.

[b][size=5]Qi's Magic Water Ball[/size][/b]
Tired of picking your way across lava rivers in the Volcano Dungeon? Mr. Qi sells
a giant water ball that douses a whole floor at once.

[b]HOW TO GET ONE[/b]
[list]
[*]Buy the [b]finished item[/b] (not a recipe) at [b]Mr. Qi's Walnut Room[/b] on
Ginger Island for [b]10 Qi Gems each[/b].[/*]
[*]Stock is [b]unlimited[/b]. The ball [b]cannot be crafted[/b] and
[b]cannot be placed[/b] on the ground — it is a throwable consumable.[/*]
[/list][b]HOW TO USE[/b]
[list]
[*]Hold a ball and enter a [b]Volcano Dungeon floor (dungeon level 1 or higher)[/b].
The entrance minecart room (level 0) does not count — trying there only shows a
red warning.[/*]
[*][b]Hold the left or right mouse button to charge[/b]: 0.2 seconds starts the
throw and 1 second is a full charge. You cannot walk while charging.[/*]
[*][b]Release to throw.[/b] The ball flies in a natural arc for [b]2-6 tiles[/b],
depending on charge (similar to casting a fishing rod).[/*]
[*]On impact it [b]instantly cools every lava tile on the current floor[/b] into
walkable hardened ground — splash sound and water-drop particles included.[/*]
[*][b]One ball is consumed per successful throw.[/b] Releasing before 0.2 seconds
cancels the throw and consumes nothing.[/*]
[*]If the floor has no uncooled lava left, you get a message and the ball is
[b]neither thrown nor consumed[/b].[/*]
[/list][b]NOTES[/b]
[list]
[*]Cooling runs on the game's own lava-cooling chain (the same one as pouring a
watering can on lava), so the hardened ground behaves exactly like vanilla.[/*]
[*]It only works inside the Volcano Dungeon — it cannot be thrown anywhere else.[/*]
[/list][b]INSTALL[/b]
Unzip into your Mods folder so that you have
Mods\VolcanoWaterBomb\manifest.json (the zip already contains the
VolcanoWaterBomb\ root folder — do not rename it), then start the game through
SMAPI. Name, description and messages switch automatically with your game
language (English / 简体中文).

[b]REQUIREMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.0.0[/b] or newer (Stardew Valley 1.6.x).[/*]
[/list][b]CONFIG (optional)[/b]
Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] and this mod shows up under [b]Mod Options[/b]. Everything is optional - the defaults are what the mod ships with:
[list]
[*][b]Shop price[/b] - Qi Gems per water ball (default 10). A shop you already have open keeps the old price until you reopen it.[/*]
[*][b]Charging[/b] - minimum charge time (default 0.2s, shorter releases count as a cancel and consume nothing) and full charge time (default 1s, which also sets how fast the meter fills). Keep the minimum below the full charge time.[/*]
[/list]Without GMCM nothing breaks: edit [b]config.json[/b] in the mod folder instead.

[b]COMPATIBILITY[/b]
Works alongside [b]CJB Item Spawner[/b], [b]Lookup Anything[/b] and [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] - all optional tools, none required; gameplay is unaffected if they are not installed.
[b][size=4]齐先生的魔法水球（中文版）[/size][/b]
还在火山地牢的岩浆河上绕来绕去？齐先生出售一种巨大水球，一发浇灭整层岩浆。
[list]
[*][b]获取[/b]：姜岛齐先生核桃房商店直接购买[b]成品[/b]（不是配方），[b]10 齐钻/个[/b]，
  库存无限。水球[b]不可制作、不可放置[/b]，是投掷消耗品。[/*]
[*][b]用法[/b]：手持水球进入[b]火山地牢楼层（地牢 level ≥ 1）[/b]；入口矿车房
  （level 0）不能用，只会出红字提示。[/*]
[*][b]按住鼠标左键或右键蓄力[/b]：0.2 秒起投、1 秒蓄满，蓄力期间无法移动。[/*]
[*][b]松手丢出[/b]：水球沿自然弧线飞行 [b]2~6 格[/b]（类似钓鱼竿抛竿距离）。[/*]
[*]落地瞬间把[b]当前楼层所有岩浆格全部浇灭[/b]为可行走的硬化地面，带水溅音效与径向
  水滴粒子。[/*]
[*][b]每次成功投掷消耗 1 个[/b]；蓄力不足 0.2 秒松手则取消，不消耗。[/*]
[*]本层已没有未冷却岩浆时会提示，[b]不丢出、不消耗[/b]。[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]原理[/b]：浇灭走原版水壶浇岩浆的同一条链路，硬化地面表现与原版完全一致。[/*]
[*][b]限制[/b]：只能在火山地牢内使用，其他地方无法投掷。[/*]
[*][b]安装[/b]：解压到 Mods 目录，使 Mods\VolcanoWaterBomb\manifest.json 存在即可
  （zip 内根目录就是 VolcanoWaterBomb\，无需改名）；物品名、描述与提示随游戏语言
  自动切换（英文 / 简体中文）。[/*]
[*][b]需求[/b]：SMAPI 4.0.0 及以上（星露谷 1.6.x），无其他依赖。[/*]
[/list][b]可选配置[/b]
装 [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b]（GMCM）后，本模组会出现在游戏「选项 → 模组选项」里，下面这些都能在游戏内改，默认值就是原本的数值：
[list]
[*][b]商店价格[/b]：一个水球的齐钻售价（默认 10）。下次打开商店时生效；已经开着的商店要重新打开才会刷新价格。[/*]
[*][b]蓄力[/b]：最短蓄力时间（默认 0.2 秒，短于它松手算取消、不消耗水球）、蓄满时间（默认 1 秒，同时决定蓄力条填充速度）。建议最短时间小于蓄满时间。[/*]
[/list]不装 GMCM 也完全正常，直接改 mod 文件夹里的 [b]config.json[/b]（键名与上面一一对应）。


[b]兼容性[/b]
与 [b]CJB Item Spawner[/b]、[b]Lookup Anything[/b]、[b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] 可共存——均为可选工具，非必需安装。

Manifest.Name: Qi's Magic Water Ball
Manifest.Description: Adds Qi's Magic Water Ball, a throwable water bomb sold at Mr. Qi's Walnut Room for 10 Qi Gems. Hold to charge (0.2-1s) and release in the Volcano Dungeon: it flies 2-6 tiles and instantly cools every lava tile on the current floor so you can walk through. One ball per throw; not craftable or placeable. Tunable in Generic Mod Config Menu.
Manifest.Author: Trae
